claims.claim: Terminal reconciliation accepts exact historical documents or the validated local document's deterministic public projection without creating another terminal.
Reconciliation preserves complete identity, correction, recovery and evidence comparisons, and blocks malformed hidden fields, duplicate JSON fields, orphaned records and conflicting terminals.
Exact historical reconciliation bypasses public-writer invocation and size limits; public comparisons retain canonical documents unchanged and do not expose private fields in observations.

Local recovery validation uses its bound canonical RUN representation, allowing an eligible unreviewed recovered RUN and candidate to reach the existing SEMANTIC_REVIEW handoff without inheriting the prior PASS.
The reducer retains existing publication-recovery validation, adds current-main binding checks, rejects duplicate canonical terminals and preserves read-only observation authority.

Focused regressions cover private/public matching and mismatches, REPAIR and REMEDIATION lineage, large historical artifacts, recovered review handoff, replay, lost wake and negative recovery bindings without replacing production validators.
